sounds.override.title: ALARM TYPES: GLOBAL / SOUND / ACKNOWLEDGEMENT
sounds.override.description: Custom rules are configured in the editor and built-in alarms in the SYSTEM tab. Vanilla alarm types can be shown or hidden globally in UNMA for all buildings and vehicles. Sound and acknowledgement remain separately configurable for Vanilla and external mod alarms. The game's own notification is not changed.
